notes: States describe DX2Ed, not T3Ed. T3Ed icon/resource presence is evidence of an authoring workflow, not proof of DX2 binary compatibility. No retail assets included.

capabilities.title: Workspace, hierarchy and inspector
capabilities.evidence: DX2Ed 0.3.1 hierarchy/inspector
capabilities.next_step: Independent tree, editable properties, docking presets

capabilities.title: 3D viewport/camera and selection
capabilities.evidence: DX2Ed Godot fly camera and triangle picking
capabilities.next_step: Orthographic viewports, snapping overlays, visibility/isolate controls

capabilities.title: Move/rotate/scale, groups, undo
capabilities.evidence: DX2Ed 0.3.0 through 0.3.2
capabilities.next_step: Parent transforms, grid/pivot configuration, native persistence

capabilities.title: Static mesh and texture browser
capabilities.evidence: DX2Ed 0.4.0 native IBD asset catalog + searchable Assets tab; original T3Ed ModeAddStaticMesh and content resources
capabilities.next_step: Asset previews, placement of uninstantiated DX2 mesh actors with validated archetypes, resource import and thumbnails

capabilities.title: Actor class palette and property browser
capabilities.evidence: DX2Ed Actor Explorer numeric IDs and class hints; 0.4.1 Inspector supports scalar bool/byte/int/float/string drafts with validation and undo. Original T3Ed actor-property workflows.
capabilities.next_step: Recover reliable DX2 Gamesys class inheritance and named field types; support object links and validated write-back only after native serializers.

capabilities.title: Editable level project/source format
capabilities.evidence: Original T3Ed content/T3/Maps/*.unr; DX2 retail maps are .gmp
capabilities.next_step: SDK-owned editable project format; GMP/IBD must remain authoritative for runtime
